text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text:
—I see. So even the wilted ones
have perked right back up...!

text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text:
I'm so glad I asked someone to look after my flowers during summer training camp.
Thank you so much, Dorm Mother, even though you're so busy.

text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text:
—Yes. As usual, the flower beds only in the morning.
The potted plants twice, morning and evening.

text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text:
Thank you very much. I know it's a bother,
but I'll be counting on you going forward as well.

text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text:
......Huh?
Something you want to tell me? What could it be—

text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text:
An Umamusume popularity poll...?
My name is... on there—?

text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text:
(Oh, it really is true.
The Breakthrough Umamusume Auditions—
my name is actually on it.)

text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text:
(I wonder if the fans
are voting for me?)

text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text:
(—Oh. If you place in the top 5,
they make a commemorative plushie of you.
There are so many comments, too...)

text_block_list.name: Umatter Comment
text_block_list.text:
('I've really been into Bouquet lately!'
'Bouquet's working so hard, she has my vote!'
'I watched the documentary three times!'—)

text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text:
(Fufu. Tomorrow,
I must tell Trainer about this too.)

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: And so, quietly, another fiery summer training camp got underway—
